project.name: KArchive / kimageformats KraHandler (saved crash in Qt/libpng PNG decode)
project.fixed_commit_note: The staged patch only changes `karchive/src/kzip.cpp` extra-field parsing by passing `n` instead of `handledextralen` into `parseExtraField`. It does not touch `kimageformats/src/imageformats/kra.cpp`, Qt's `qpnghandler.cpp`, bundled libpng's IHDR handling, or the saved `QSize::operator!=` sink, so it cannot be treated as demonstrated remediation for this crash path.

analysis_state.reason: Stage 01 reproduced the saved MSAN crash in `QSize::operator!=` on the Kra -> Qt PNG path. The exact staged source establishes both the stack-allocation site MSAN names and the later overwrite site: `setup_qt()` allocates local `width`, `height`, and `interlace_method` without initialization, but `readPngHeader()` calls `png_read_info()`, bundled libpng's `png_handle_IHDR()` and `png_set_IHDR()` populate `info_ptr`, and `setup_qt()` then calls `png_get_IHDR()` to copy those fields into the locals before `QSize outSize(width,height)`. With `runtime_disambiguation` disabled and the staged patch unrelated to this path, the available artifacts do not close a source-grounded explanation for how uninitialized state would survive past that copy to the sink.

bug_description.normalized: Stage 01 reproduced the MemorySanitizer crash at `QSize::operator!=` while `KraHandler::read()` was decoding the archive member `mergedimage.png` through Qt's PNG loader. The exact staged source shows two competing source-level facts on that path: `setup_qt()` allocates local `width`, `height`, and `interlace_method` stack variables without initialization, matching the saved MSAN `width.i` allocation context, but `readPngHeader()` calls `png_read_info()`, bundled libpng's `png_handle_IHDR()` and `png_set_IHDR()` populate `info_ptr`, and `setup_qt()` then calls `png_get_IHDR()` to copy those fields into the locals before `QSize outSize(width,height)` and the size comparison. The saved artifacts therefore prove the sink and the stack-allocation context, while the staged source still does not provide a source-grounded way for uninitialized state to survive past `png_get_IHDR()` on the witnessed path. The staged patch is unrelated to this Kra/Qt/libpng flow.

source.description: First project-code materialization of the inner PNG bytes on the witnessed crash path. `KraHandler::read()` has already selected the archive member `mergedimage.png`, and this read copies that member into a `QByteArray` later handed to Qt's PNG decoder.
source.value_from: Stage 01's reproduced stack reaches `KraHandler::read(QImage*)` at `kimageformats/src/imageformats/kra.cpp:47`, where the handler explicitly looks up `mergedimage.png` and immediately calls `fileZipEntry->data()` before `image->loadFromData(..., "PNG")`. Line 1427 is therefore the first project-side statement that materializes the executed member bytes.

tainted_value_origin.description: Bundled libpng stores the attacker-derived IHDR metadata into `info_ptr`; `setup_qt()` later copies this parser state back into its local `width`, `height`, `bit_depth`, `color_type`, and `interlace_method` with `png_get_IHDR()`.

sink.description: Exact saved MSAN sink. `s2` is the `outSize` object constructed in `setup_qt()` and passed through the size comparison at `qpnghandler.cpp:403`.
sink.note: The saved report proves the read at this operator. The unresolved point is whether the stack-local state MSAN attributes to `width.i` still survives after `setup_qt()` calls `png_get_IHDR()` to populate `width` and `height` from `info_ptr`.

root_cause.description: Source-level stack-allocation site matching the saved MSAN allocation context. `setup_qt()` creates local `width`, `height`, and `interlace_method` without initialization here before later passing them as out-parameters to `png_get_IHDR()`.
root_cause.note: The saved MSAN origin names `width.i` in the inlined `setup_qt()` frame inside `QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage`. Stage 02 keeps this declaration as the allocation-context anchor, but the sample remains unresolved because line 244 should overwrite these locals from `info_ptr` before the sink and the staged artifacts do not show how that write fails or is bypassed.

parser_admitted.description: Qt's PNG parser is only used if the first eight bytes match the PNG signature. The witnessed call chain reaches `readPngImage()` / `setup_qt()`, so this gate is passed on the saved path.

evidence_limitations: The staged patch fixes `karchive/src/kzip.cpp` extra-field parsing, not the `KraHandler` / Qt / bundled-libpng path in the saved MSAN stack. It does not demonstrate remediation or direct relevance to this crash path.

The exact staged source shows `png_read_info()` parsing IHDR, `png_handle_IHDR()` extracting width/height, `png_set_IHDR()` storing them into `info_ptr`, and `png_get_IHDR()` copying those fields into `setup_qt()`'s local `width` and `height` before `QSize outSize(width,height)`. The available artifacts therefore do not close a source-grounded explanation for how MSAN's `width.i` origin survives to the sink.

In bundled libpng, `png_get_IHDR()` only skips those assignments if `png_ptr == NULL || info_ptr == NULL` and returns 0, but the staged source plus saved run do not establish that condition on the witnessed path. `run_flags.json` also sets `runtime_disambiguation` to `false`, so Stage 02 must remain source-grounded and cannot add marker instrumentation.

coarse_trace.summary: KArchive materializes the `mergedimage.png` member bytes from the staged KRA witness.
KraHandler forwards those bytes to `QImage::loadFromData(..., "PNG")`, forcing the downstream Qt PNG decoder.
Bundled libpng parses IHDR and stores width, height, and related metadata in `info_ptr`.

`setup_qt()` allocates local width/height stack slots, then calls `png_get_IHDR()` to copy the stored IHDR fields into them before constructing `outSize`; this is the source-grounded point where the saved MSAN origin and the staged overwrite path diverge.
`QSize::operator!=` reads `outSize.wd` / `outSize.ht` and matches the saved MSAN sink, but the source-grounded chain into a surviving uninitialized `outSize` field remains unresolved.

fine_trace.note: After `KraHandler::read()` resolves the archive member `mergedimage.png`, `createDevice()` returns a device limited to that member. `readAll()` copies the member bytes into `arr`, the `QByteArray` later handed to Qt's PNG loader.
KraHandler forwards the member bytes from step 1 into Qt and forces PNG dispatch with the explicit format string `"PNG"`.
Parser admission. The saved call chain reaches Qt's PNG handler, and this signature check is the gate that keeps execution on the PNG path into `readPngImage()` and `setup_qt()`.

fine_trace.var: buf, width, height, bit_depth, color_type, interlace_type
fine_trace.note: During `readPngHeader()`'s `png_read_info()` call, bundled libpng dispatches the IHDR chunk here and decodes the 13-byte header payload into local metadata values. Adjacent lines 861-866 derive `height`, `bit_depth`, `color_type`, and `interlace_type` from the same `buf`.
Libpng stores the parsed IHDR metadata from step 4 into the persistent `info_ptr` structure. This is the source-grounded parser state that `setup_qt()` later reads back with `png_get_IHDR()`.

`setup_qt()` allocates the PNG metadata locals on the stack without initialization. The saved MSAN origin explicitly names `width.i` from this inlined frame, so this declaration is the only source-level stack-allocation site matching the reported origin.

Qt calls bundled libpng to copy `info_ptr` metadata into the step-6 locals before any `outSize` comparison. In `pngget.c`, `png_get_IHDR()` only skips these assignments if `png_ptr == NULL || info_ptr == NULL` and returns 0, but the staged source and saved run do not establish that condition on the witnessed path. This is therefore the source-grounded point where the sink-reaching uninitialized-state chain becomes unresolved.

The copied IHDR fields determine whether the sink block is reachable. The saved stack reaches line 403 in the trailing `else` block, so this final 16-bit-only guard is false on the witnessed path and control falls into the 32-bit block at lines 376-418.

The current `width` and `height` locals are packaged into `outSize`. If the saved MSAN report reflects the step-6 stack state, that poison must survive step 7 into this constructor; the exact staged source does not show how.

This exact project-side callsite passes `outSize` into `QSize::operator!=` on the saved MSAN stack. Because step 7 should already have filled `width` and `height`, this step is call-path evidence into the sink rather than a closed project-side proof that `outSize` is still uninitialized.

Sink. The saved `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` report fires on this read while comparing `image.size()` against `outSize`. The staged source proves the call path into this operator, but not how an uninitialized `outSize` field would persist after step 7.

allocation_context.note: The saved MSAN origin says the uninitialized value was created by allocation of `width.i` in this stack frame.

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: Yes at allocation-context granularity. The saved origin names `width.i` in `QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage`'s stack frame, and the only matching source-level stack allocation site is the inlined `setup_qt()` declaration at `qpnghandler.cpp:234`. The staged source does not prove that this local state survives step 7's `png_get_IHDR()` copy.
cross_validation.trace_consistent_with_stack: Yes. The saved stack `KraHandler::read -> QImage::loadFromData -> QImageReader::read -> QPngHandler::read -> QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage -> setup_qt -> operator!=` matches fine-trace steps 1-11, and steps 4-7 make the intervening libpng IHDR state explicit.
cross_validation.tainted_value_reaches_sink: Yes at metadata-reachability granularity: the IHDR-derived fields stored in `info_ptr` at step 5 are copied into `setup_qt()` locals at step 7, packaged into `outSize` at step 9, and read at the sink at step 11. The unresolved part is whether the uninitialized local state named by MSAN survives the same path after step 7.
cross_validation.patch_resolves_note: The staged patch only changes `karchive/src/kzip.cpp` extra-field parsing and does not touch `KraHandler`, `qpnghandler.cpp`, bundled libpng's IHDR handling, or `QSize::operator!=`, so it cannot be used as fix proof for the saved MSAN sink.

poc.trigger: Stage 01 reproduced the crash by running `PYTHONPATH=gt_generation python3 -m gt_toolkit arvo-workspace --result-dir /mnt/datastore/gt_generation/gt_results/arvo_14040 run --version vulnerable --expect crash`, which fed the exact staged `poc` into `kimgio_fuzzer`. The run entered `KraHandler::read`, explicitly requested `mergedimage.png`, forwarded that member to `QImage::loadFromData(..., "PNG")`, and reached the saved MSAN sink in `QSize::operator!=`.

format.name: exact staged malformed KRA/ZIP witness
format.contract: The only trigger semantics established here are those of the exact staged `poc`. Passive inspection with `zipinfo` shows a truncated/corrupt ZIP/KRA container (`missing 13621 bytes in zipfile`, `start of central directory not found`), yet the saved run proves KArchive still parses far enough for `KraHandler::read()` to request `mergedimage.png` and force Qt's explicit PNG load path. The available artifacts do not justify generalizing beyond this exact witness and its observed call-chain behavior.
